newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK MAY INFLATION TO FALL TO 5.3-5.4PCT Y/Y.
newsitem.headline: GREEK MAY INFLATION TO FALL TO 5.3-5.4PCT Y/Y.

text.p: Greek CPI-based inflation will drop to 5.3 or 5.4 percent year-on-year in May from 5.9 percent in April, a government source told Reuters.
"It is not true that inflation will fall to 5.0 or 5.1 or even 5.2 percent year-on-year in May," the source said. "It will be between 5.3 and 5.4 percent."
The official inflation figure will be released by the National Statistics Service later today. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
